candidates.name: c07_temp_space_type
candidates.sql: SELECT NAME, TYPE$ FROM V$TABLESPACE

candidates.name: c08_temp_space_usage
candidates.sql: SELECT NAME, ROUND(TOTAL_SIZE * PAGE / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) as TOTAL_MB, ROUND(USED_SIZE * PAGE / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) as USED_MB FROM V$TABLESPACE WHERE TYPE$='TEMP'

candidates.name: c09_sysstat_sql
candidates.sql: SELECT NAME, STAT_VAL FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE UPPER(NAME) LIKE '%SQL%'

candidates.name: c10_sysstat_cache
candidates.sql: SELECT NAME, STAT_VAL FROM V$SYSSTAT WHERE UPPER(NAME) LIKE '%CACHE%' OR UPPER(NAME) LIKE '%SORT%'

candidates.name: c11_io_stat
candidates.sql: SELECT TYPE, COUNT, PAGES, COST FROM V$IO_STAT

candidates.name: c12_sql_history_top
candidates.sql: SELECT TOP_SQL_TEXT, TIME_USED, AFFECTED_ROWS, N_LOGIC_READ, N_PHY_READ FROM V$SQL_HISTORY WHERE TIME_USED IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TIME_USED DESC

candidates.name: c13_sql_history_group
candidates.sql: SELECT SQL_ID, SUBSTR(TOP_SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT, COUNT(*) as EXECUTE_COUNT, SUM(TIME_USED) as ELAPSED_TIME, SUM(AFFECTED_ROWS) as ROWS_PROCESSED, SUM(N_LOGIC_READ + N_PHY_READ) as BUFFER_GETS FROM V$SQL_HISTORY GROUP BY SQL_ID, TOP_SQL_TEXT ORDER BY EXECUTE_COUNT DESC

candidates.name: c14_sql_history_rownum
candidates.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT SQL_ID, SUBSTR(TOP_SQL_TEXT,1,200) as SQL_TEXT, COUNT(*) as EXECUTE_COUNT, SUM(TIME_USED) as AVG_TIME FROM V$SQL_HISTORY GROUP BY SQL_ID, TOP_SQL_TEXT ORDER BY EXECUTE_COUNT DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

candidates.name: c15_lock_join
candidates.sql: SELECT t.SESS_ID, s.USER_NAME, t.ID as TRANSACTION_ID, SUBSTR(s.SQL_TEXT,1,200) as SQL_TEXT, l.LMODE, l.BLOCKED FROM V$LOCK l LEFT JOIN V$TRX t ON l.TRX_ID = t.ID LEFT JOIN V$SESSIONS s ON t.SESS_ID = s.SESS_ID WHERE l.BLOCKED = 1

candidates.name: c16_lock_count_blocked
candidates.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$LOCK WHERE BLOCKED = 1

candidates.name: c17_session_detail
candidates.sql: SELECT SESS_ID, USER_NAME, STATE, CLNT_IP, CLNT_HOST, APPNAME, SUBSTR(SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT, TRX_ID FROM V$SESSIONS WHERE USER_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY STATE, SESS_ID LIMIT 100

candidates.name: c18_session_limit_only
candidates.sql: SELECT SESS_ID, USER_NAME, STATE, CLNT_IP, CLNT_HOST, APPNAME, SUBSTR(SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT, TRX_ID FROM V$SESSIONS WHERE USER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM <= 100 ORDER BY STATE, SESS_ID

candidates.name: c19_session_run_status
candidates.sql: SELECT RUN_STATUS, COUNT(*) FROM V$SESSIONS GROUP BY RUN_STATUS

candidates.name: c20_long_trx
candidates.sql: SELECT t.ID as TRX_ID, t.SESS_ID, t.STATUS, (SYSDATE - s.CREATE_TIME) * 86400 as DURATION_SEC, SUBSTR(s.SQL_TEXT, 1, 200) as SQL_TEXT FROM V$TRX t LEFT JOIN V$SESSIONS s ON t.SESS_ID = s.SESS_ID WHERE (SYSDATE - s.CREATE_TIME) * 86400 > 60 ORDER BY DURATION_SEC DESC

candidates.name: c21_trx_cols

candidates.name: c22_deadlock
candidates.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT SESS_ID, TRX_ID, SQL_TEXT, HAPPEN_TIME FROM V$DEADLOCK_HISTORY ORDER BY HAPPEN_TIME DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
